claim: TD3 is the single-actor twin-critic extension of DDPG
notes: The full method uses one actor, two critics, three target networks.

claim: Deterministic actor-critic may exploit overestimation caused by approximate critic
notes: Not restricted to discrete-action max operators.

claim: Clipped double-Q uses the minimum of two target critics on the same target action
notes: Both critics regress toward the same minimum target; possible underestimation.

claim: Target policy smoothing adds clipped Gaussian noise to the target action
notes: Action bound clipping is noted as modern implementation practice.

claim: Delayed actor and target updates every d critic steps
notes: Experimental choice d=2; two time scales are not a universal theorem.

claim: Polyak target rate follows target <- tau online +(1-tau) target
notes: Paper tau=0.005; parameter name differs from rho near one.

claim: Algorithm 1 updates both critics before delayed actor and targets
notes: Gradient target is detached in modern implementations.

claim: Experiments used 400 and 300 hidden units and Adam 1e-3
notes: Original 2018 paper architecture and optimizer, not universal settings.
